How do I become less social akward?

(English is not my first language, Apologize in advance)

I (f18) have ADHD and social anxiety. Most of the time I love being around people. I've got one friend from a previous school whom I sometimes hang out with against she's very quiet, one really good online friend since 4 years, and many acquaintances that I'm less close with.

I have always been very social and outgoing no matter the person, young, old, man or woman. For some unknown reason I've just always gotten along better with older people. And I would say my emotional intelligence and empathy is quite high despite being neurodivergent. This has led to me often being friending the people that can be precived as "outsiders" or just "weird." I just love making others laugh, making a fool of myself for entertainment, because I often don't give a shit.

My problem is that I've had a tough time the past few years. Which has taken a great toll on my social life. A year ago I started at a new school were mostly no one knew eatchother, I always prefer to take a step back and observe people in the beginning. Now a year later I feel like an outsider.

I feel like others perceive me as weird. And I get that! Some days I will be the most social, impulsive and interactive person you've ever met. Other times I will be perserved, quiet and full of anxiety. I know it's weird cause I feel weird, for me the world has always felt unreal from my eyes.

What I think I'm trying to say is that I've been feeling extremely Lonley for a while and I need advice on how I can deepen my relationships with my classmates and others. I hate the feeling of being alone, the only social time I have is at school.

I feel like I need and want more friends that are more outgoing. I have good bases with some of my classmates but I have no idea of how to deepen those friendships without being overly expensive. Especially when it comes to guys since I don't want them to think that I'm desperate for something else.

Yeah, so my appologies for the long text. I appreciate any advice <3
